production_controls: Access control is default-deny and deny-overrides, with enforcement left to the resource service.
Encryption and key-management KAs process metadata only and require an authoritative OS-backed crypto/key service.
Threat detection is runtime-signal evaluation and remains distinct from design-time threat modeling.
Vulnerability scanning qualifies supplied scanner results and never claims a scan was executed.
Incident response produces an unapplied ordered plan.
External deep research requires connector, policy, and human approval and performs no network or memory operation.
All seven canonical IDs have one unique source owner and no unscoped alias.
open_work: Qualify remaining pre-existing implementation surfaces and authoritative effect-service integration.
Complete CP18-D through CP18-H before rebuilding or releasing.
Retain all installed, manual, accessibility, security, signing, independent-review, and soak gates.
